title: Dead Water
summary: Dace Pike says the harvesters' leaders at the vats never look behind them, because nothing down there ever has. Get behind five, and he'll show your rogues what Wren puts on her knives (the rogue's level-12 skill).

steps.journal: Defeat five of the Canal Locks' wave-leaders: every fifth wave, the harvester whose cage glows, an orange bar over it.

ready: Five of their leaders, unseen. Tell Dace Pike at the Drowned Eel in Saltmere.
done: Dace taught your rogues Venom. Wren taught it him, to clear a page of what she owes.
